name: Kinvesper Alerts
short_description: Care alerts about your parent from Kinvesper, their Alexa care companion.
description:
Kinvesper looks after an older parent through Alexa: medicines, check-ins, scam calls and emergencies. This bot sends the family its alerts. Tap ✅ I'm on it to mark one handled, 📋 Status for today, or type a message and Kinvesper reads it out on the Echo.

To connect, open the Kinvesper dashboard, go to Settings and press Connect Telegram.

commands.description: Today: doses, check-in and open alerts
Mark the newest alert as handled
